example.before: // Single module with multiple concerns // monitor.rs handles: monitoring, validation, persistence, UI

pattern.name: interface_boundary
pattern.when_to_use: Modules need to communicate with each other

example.before: // Direct coupling between modules // Daemon directly calls Monitor internals

pattern.name: repository_pattern
pattern.description: Abstract data access behind repository interface
pattern.when_to_use: Business logic needs to access data

example.before: // Business logic directly calls storage // EntropyCalculator directly writes to disk

pattern.name: event_driven
pattern.when_to_use: Modules need to react to state changes

example.before: // Tight coupling through direct calls // Monitor directly calls UI to update display
// Mixed concerns // Functions mix business logic, storage, and presentation

pattern.name: dependency_injection
pattern.description: Inject dependencies instead of creating them

example.before: // Hard dependency // Monitor creates its own Storage instance
